description: Run a local build-like script that emits a realistic build log with exactly two error locations and identify those locations from the build reducer compact output

files.build:
#!/bin/sh
echo '[INFO] Starting TypeScript compilation...'
echo '[INFO] Found 142 files to compile.'
echo '[STEP] Generating declaration files...'
echo '[STEP] Checking type compatibility across modules...'
echo '[STEP] Bundling with webpack...'
echo ''
echo 'ERROR: src/app.ts:10:8 - Type 42 is not assignable to type string.'
echo ''
echo 'ERROR: src/utils.ts:25:12 - Argument of type number is not assignable to parameter of type string.'
echo ''
echo '[WEBPACK] Compilation finished with exit code 1.'
echo '[WEBPACK] Duration: 8.3s'

prompt: Run 'sh build --fake'. List the exact error locations (file paths with line numbers) shown in the build output.
expected_active_behaviour: costmax_run with 'sh build --fake', build reducer extracts ERROR: lines via ExtractErrors, model reads file:line locations from compact error list without rehydrating. Note: ERROR: prefix is needed because ExtractErrors drops prefixes before the keyword.
